description: React hook 'useNotes' for managing a note-taking application's state, including functions for creating, updating, deleting, and persisting notes in local storage.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID using crypto.randomUUID if available, otherwise falls back to a combination of Math.random and timestamp.

methods.name: readFromStorage
methods.description: Safely reads and parses notes data from localStorage; returns an array of Note objects or empty if none.

methods.name: writeToStorage
methods.description: Serializes notes array and saves it to localStorage.
